+    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);

+          case RelayStatus.warning:
+            statusIcon = const Icon(

+              color: Colors.orange,
+              size: Sizes.iconSmall,

+            break;
+          case RelayStatus.disconnected:
+            statusIcon = const Icon(
+              Icons.cancel,
+              color: Colors.red,
+              size: Sizes.iconSmall,
+            );
+            break;
+          default:
+            statusIcon = const SizedBox(width: Sizes.iconSmall, height: Sizes.iconSmall);
+        }
+
+        return Row(
+          spacing: Sizes.indent,
+          children: [
+            SizedBox(width: Sizes.iconSmall, child: Center(child: statusIcon)),

+            Expanded(

+            Checkbox(value: widget.isSelected, onChanged: widget.onChanged),

+}

+final class RelayTileVM extends ChangeNotifier {
+  final String url;
+  late final RelaysMonitoringRepo relaysMonitoringRepo = DiStorage.shared.resolve();
+  StreamSubscription<Map<String, RelayStatus>>? _sub;
+  RelayStatus? status;
+
+  RelayTileVM(this.url) {
+    _sub = relaysMonitoringRepo.relaysStatus.listen(_onRelaysStatus);
+  }
+
+  void _onRelaysStatus(Map<String, RelayStatus> map) {
+    final newStatus = map[url];
+    if (newStatus != status) {
+      status = newStatus;
+      notifyListeners();
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void dispose() {
+    _sub?.cancel();
+    super.dispose();
+  }
+}

**Resolving runtime error**

I noticed that in the patch, I declared `vm` as `late final RelayTileVM vm;`, which allows assignment only once. In `didUpdateWidget`, the code calls `vm.dispose()` and reassigns `vm`, causing a runtime error since final can't be reassigned. I need to change the declaration to `late RelayTileVM vm;`.
